page.title: Learned Patterns
page.description: Review and manage code patterns learned from agent sessions

component.title: Pattern Review
component.description: Review learned code patterns and mark them as team standards or deprecated.
component.emptyDescription: Patterns are extracted during agent code generation sessions and stored in Graphiti memory.

legend.title: About Pattern Confidence:
legend.high: High confidence (90%+): Pattern used frequently and consistently
legend.medium: Medium confidence (70-90%): Pattern used moderately, may need review
legend.low: Low confidence (<70%): Pattern used infrequently, verify before approving
legend.approved: Approved patterns are marked as team standards (confidence: 100%)
legend.deprecated: Deprecated patterns are marked to avoid (confidence: 0%)
